an exchanged token never carries a higher acr than its subject
consumer_must: require acr/auth_time per sensitive action and refuse when absent or stale
treat any requirement above the password level as unavailable today
denied: caller-supplied acr/amr parameters are ignored (assurance is never caller-written)
a workload token asserts no human authentication
a customer token asserts no acr/auth_time (customer assurance is not modelled)

facts.deferred: native MFA/passkeys; assurance vocabulary beyond password (IDP-15 profile not selected)
